QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_27

question.text: How does GST apply to investment management and trusteeship fees paid by an AIF?

answer.text: GST does not apply to services provided by the Investment Manager and Trustee to the Fund
GST applies at the applicable rate on investment management and trusteeship fees
GST applies only to performance fees and not to management fees
GST applies only to trusteeship fees and not to investment management fees

explanation.text: The Logic: GST applies to services provided by the Investment Manager and Trustee to the Fund, levied at the applicable rate on investment management and trusteeship fees. The Trap: Suggesting non-applicability or carving out specific fee components contradicts the source, which treats both investment management and trusteeship fees as taxable services. Note: Source page 265 of Series XIX-A AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook; a specific GST rate is not cited here.
